function_v0.doc: Resolves a claimed username to its owning address, or `None` if it\nis unclaimed (or was never valid to begin with).
function_v0.name: resolve

function_v0.doc:
Claims `username` for `user`. Permanent: once claimed a username can
never be released, changed, or transferred, and each address may
claim only one. `username` must already be lowercase - the contract
rejects anything else rather than silently normalizing it, so a
caller never claims a different string than what it typed.
function_v0.name: register

function_v0.doc: Returns the username `user` has claimed, if any.
function_v0.name: username_of

function_v0.doc: True if `username` is well-formed AND still unclaimed.
function_v0.name: is_available
